### 2026-10-04 — So, I finished coding my temp sensor, then polishing the if-else loops for the servo, then Integrating a piezo and then a DC motor (i'm planning on adding a fan onto it.) On top of that, I'm also plan

**7h**

So, I finished coding my temp sensor, then polishing the if-else loops for the servo, then Integrating a piezo and then a DC motor (i'm planning on adding a fan onto it.) On top of that, I'm also planning on adding an LCD screen to show the current temperature without having to look at the computer.
